svg.title: Tortie Moon Conservatory — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: A curled tortoiseshell cat with dense amber, copper, umber, and near-black coat mosaics beneath a moon window. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.
svg.metadata: {"slug": "tortie-moon-conservatory", "title": "Tortie Moon Conservatory", "desc": "A curled tortoiseshell cat with dense amber, copper, umber, and near-black coat mosaics beneath a moon window.", "tags": ["Tortie Cat", "Botanical", "Mosaic", "OurSpace Original"], "palette": [{"hex": "#F1E1C5", "name": "Warm paper"}, {"hex": "#D0B084", "name": "Wood trim"}, {"hex": "#B9785D", "name": "Night terracotta"}, {"hex": "#725047", "name": "Window umber"}, {"hex": "#4A403D", "name": "Moon ring"}, {"hex": "#C7D0B9", "name": "Moon glow"}, {"hex": "#6E8D7D", "name": "Star jade"}, {"hex": "#718267", "name": "Leaf olive"}, {"hex": "#506353", "name": "Leaf moss"}, {"hex": "#A9874D", "name": "Floor ochre"}, {"hex": "#B86F5D", "name": "Rug rust"}, {"hex": "#332F2E", "name": "Tortie base"}, {"hex": "#5A4339", "name": "Head umber"}, {"hex": "#1E2222", "name": "Near-black patch"}, {"hex": "#4B352D", "name": "Deep umber patch"}, {"hex": "#B76535", "name": "Copper patch"}, {"hex": "#D78A3D", "name": "Amber patch"}, {"hex": "#E8C28B", "name": "Cream fleck"}, {"hex": "#C99A4D", "name": "Gold fleck"}, {"hex": "#E9D8B8", "name": "Cream blaze"}, {"hex": "#91A873", "name": "Green eyes"}, {"hex": "#191D1C", "name": "Pupils"}, {"hex": "#A56561", "name": "Rose-brown nose"}, {"hex": "#A8AE9A", "name": "Pot stone"}], "complexity": "Detailed"}
